items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Basically stuff like Basie, Jimmy Lunceford, Benny Goodman, John Coltrane, you know people like that. It’s background.

ctx.x: Do you hear new stuff that you like, that perks your ear up.
Every now and then. Basically stuff like Basie, Jimmy Lunceford, Benny Goodman, John Coltrane, you know people like that. It’s background. Until I turn on the T.V. and I turn it off.
